en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a rural village scene, likely from the early 20th century. In the foreground, there are cows grazing on a grassy field. Behind them, there is a row of traditional European-style houses with steep roofs. Several flagpoles are visible, each flying what appears to be the Norwegian flag. In the background, a church with a tall spire can be seen rising above the trees. The word 'Ulvikdal' is printed on the lower left corner.
